answer: Admission auction stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch auctions 100 slots; applicants bid non-refundable POA, and only the top 100 win, ranked on a public trellis of open offers. Winners lock the bid for 20 epochs, a marble-hard record, and forfeit it if caught cloning. When a gale of fake bids arrives, rivals push the price up: at 40 POA each, 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA, while one honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
